summary: External-runtime adapter for Codex (first), with a durable out-of-band record stream and a stable renderer projection. The adapter is an agent backend; the UI slot renders the projection and the host task graph consumes the records.

configuration.description: External runtime adapter: codex for the live Codex CLI, fake for the deterministic simulated journal.
Durable OAR journal directory; defaults to the host-provided plugin data directory.
Default working directory passed to the external runtime.
Codex executable path; defaults to codex on PATH. A missing executable is a typed runtime_unavailable preflight failure.
Optional model override passed to the Codex runtime; empty uses the runtime default.

examples.title: Run one Codex turn
examples.description: Start the OAR sidecar with the codex runtime and send a task; records carry sessionId/taskId attribution out of band.

examples.title: Replay a deterministic journal
examples.description: Use the fake runtime to exercise call/result folding and the renderer projection without a live model.

limits.name: record_sequence
limits.description: Every record carries a monotonic seq and an agentPath; the journal never reorders a published record.

limits.name: process_group_cleanup
limits.description: Sidecar and external runtime process groups are terminated and reaped after exit, crash or cancellation.

limits.name: live_model_preflight
limits.description: A simulated or unavailable runtime is refused before a live model turn; it is never silently treated as a real model.
